ask.keys_choice: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to confirm · Esc: previous question · Ctrl+C: give up
ask.keys_list: Enter to add, Enter on an empty line to finish · Backspace on an empty line: remove the last one · Esc: previous question
ask.keys_multi: ↑ ↓ to move, Space to tick or untick, Enter to confirm · Esc: previous question
ask.keys_text: Enter to confirm (empty: the suggested value) · Esc: previous question · Ctrl+C: give up
cli.log_failed: The log cannot be created, nothing was launched: %v
cli.usage:
pm %s — runs a program and frames it.

  pm run   <config.yaml> [--profile NAME] [--tray]           before actions → launch → wait for the end → after actions
  pm watch <config.yaml> [--profile NAME] [--tray|--no-tui] keeps the program alive (restarts), before/after actions around the session
  pm check <config.yaml> [--profile NAME]                   validates the config and shows what would be done
  pm shortcut <config.yaml> [--profile NAME]              creates the Windows shortcuts the shortcuts section describes
  pm new [config.yaml]                                    wizard: a few questions, and the config is ready
  pm version

  --tray          an icon in the notification area instead of the console window (or ui: tray in the config)
  --icon FILE     the image of that icon, .ico (32-bit or PNG) or .png (or icon: in the config)
  --lang fr|en    pm's language (or PM_LANG, or lang: in the config; else Windows')
config.bad_kill_on_exit: kill_on_exit: %q must be a process name alone, extension included (e.g. SR-ClientRadio.exe)
config.bad_shortcut_name: shortcuts.name: %q is not a valid file name
config.bad_sync: sync: %q is not of the form "profile <-> live"
config.bad_track: track: %q must be a process name alone, extension included (e.g. dcs.exe)
config.dup_source: sync: %s is the source of two lines (to %s and %s)
config.dup_target: sync: %s is the target of two lines (%s and %s)
config.name: name: %w
config.no_profiles: profile %q asked for, but %s defines no profile
config.one_action: an action holds exactly one of copy, delete, exec
config.one_document: %s: a single YAML document expected (a stray --- separator?)
config.ready_file_required: ready.file is required when ready is set
config.var_loop: variable ${%s} refers back to itself (circular definition)
icon.depth: %d-bit ICO image: only 32-bit or PNG images are read
lock.busy: another pm session is already active
lock.busy_owner: another pm session is already active: %s
menu.check: check a config (what would be done, without running anything)
menu.h_add_section: Two questions, then a shortcuts section is added at the end of the file; the rest of the file does not change.
menu.mode_run: start the program once, with its before and after actions (pm run)
menu.new: create a config (the wizard: a few questions, and it is ready)
menu.q_add_section: This config does not say yet which shortcuts to create: add it
menu.q_ui: During a session, pm shows itself
menu.title: pm %s — Process Monitor
menu.ui_tray: as an icon in the notification area (no window; advised for a game)
plan.missing_total: %d missing source(s): pm run would fail before launching anything.
proc.assign_failed: cannot put the process in the Job Object (%v), following the launched process only
proc.launcher_lingers: %s has exited, but its launcher still runs (%s): waiting for it
proc.left_job: %s (pid %d) left the Job Object, now tracked by its name
proc.leftovers: %s has exited; processes started during the session and not waited for: %s
proc.never_appeared: %s never appeared (the launcher exited with code %d)
proc.no_job: Job Object unavailable (%v), following the launched process only
run.ctrlc_cancel: Ctrl+C again within 5 s to cancel: nothing will be launched, the live files will be put back as they were
run.ctrlc_detach: Ctrl+C again within 5 s to detach: the program will keep running, the after actions will NOT run
run.ctrlc_end: Ctrl+C again within 5 s to end without restarting: nothing runs, the after actions will run
run.detached: pm stops, the program keeps running unsupervised
run.ended_code: session over, the program returned code %d
run.window_closed: window closed: pm is cut off, the after actions will NOT run
session.already_running: %s already runs (pid %v) outside this session: nothing was copied or launched. Close it, or set if_running: kill
session.before_failed: before actions failed, %s was not launched: %w
session.cancelled: session cancelled before the launch: live files put back, nothing was launched
session.detached: session detached: %s still runs, the after actions (copy-back included) do NOT run
session.ready_timeout: %s still missing after %s: the program starts badly or has changed
session.replay_before: before actions run again before the restart
session.safety_net: %s %s: after actions NOT run, so as to copy nothing back while it runs
session.stale_ready_kept: the old ready file cannot be deleted (%v): the start will not be followed
session.survived_kill: %s still there after being stopped (pid %v, %v): nothing was copied or launched
shortcut.icon_not_written: profile %q of %s: the icon could not be added (profile written on one line?); add it by hand with the icon key
shortcut.no_section: %s: no shortcuts section (add for example "shortcuts: { mode: run }")
shortcut.taskbar_hint: For the taskbar: in the Start menu, right-click the shortcut, then "Pin to taskbar".
shortcut.ui_not_written: %s: the ui key could not be added; add it by hand
tray.ask_cancel: Cancel the session? Nothing will be launched, the live files will be put back as they were.
tray.ask_detach: Detach pm? The program keeps running unsupervised, and the after actions (copy-back included) will NOT run.
tray.ask_end: End without restarting? Nothing runs: the after actions will run.
tray.detach_hint: pm stops, the program keeps running
tray.stop_hint: Stops the program, then runs the after actions
tui.q_cancel: again to cancel: nothing will be launched, the live files will be put back as they were
tui.q_detach: again to detach: the program keeps running, the after actions will NOT run
tui.q_end: again to end without restarting: the after actions will run
wizard.bad_choice: %q is not one of the choices
wizard.bad_count: %q: a number from 1 up is expected
wizard.bad_icon: %s: a .ico icon or a .png image is expected
wizard.bad_profile: %q: a profile name made of letters, digits, - _ and ., not starting with -
wizard.bad_track: %q: a process name alone is expected, extension included (e.g. game.exe)
wizard.case.backup: back up a folder before starting a program
wizard.case.dcs: start DCS World with profiles (DEV, VR…)
wizard.case.watch: keep a program alive (restarted when it stops)
wizard.config_exists: %s already exists: pm new never changes a config, choose another name
wizard.config_in_root: the config cannot be inside %s, a folder the wizard watches: choose another folder
wizard.current_none: none: all are set up by playing
wizard.game_running: %s is already running (pid %v): close it before going on, or stop it from here
wizard.h.clean: Temporary files that keep the program from restarting cleanly, for example. Nothing to delete: an empty line.
wizard.h.current: That profile takes the settings as they are, without starting the game. The others are set up by playing, one after the other.
wizard.h.dcs_launcher: It is in the bin folder of the DCS installation.
wizard.h.icon: It shows on the shortcuts and in the notification area. The icons offered are the ones found next to the config.
wizard.h.name: It names the config file and the shortcuts: "dcs - DEV", "dcs - VR"… It is not a profile name.
wizard.h.profiles: For each profile the game will start: set it up as wanted for that profile, then quit it. pm finds out by itself which files changed.
wizard.h.review: Untick a file that was not meant to change: this profile keeps its original version.
wizard.h.roots: While each profile is set up, pm watches what changes in these folders.
wizard.h.seed: The chosen files are put in place before the game starts; the report after the game shows them with the rest.
wizard.h.seed_to_new: No file of that name in the game: check the suggested path.
wizard.h.track: Some launchers start the game and exit: pm must then follow the game itself, by its process name.
wizard.learn: The game starts for profile %s: set everything as wanted for this profile, then quit the game.
wizard.no_back: no going back here: the step before already touched the files
wizard.not_absolute: %s: a full path is expected (e.g. C:\Games\game.exe)
wizard.not_in_roots: %s: the file must go into a watched folder (%s)
wizard.not_interactive: pm new asks questions: run it in a terminal
wizard.profile_exists: %s already exists: the wizard does not write into a profile folder it did not create, choose another name or another folder for the config
wizard.q.clean: Files or folders to delete before each start (one per line, empty line to finish)
wizard.q.current: Which profile is the current setup
wizard.q.name: Config name (e.g. dcs)
wizard.q.profiles: Profiles to create (one per line, empty line to finish)
wizard.q.review: Files changed while playing profile %s (Space to untick)
wizard.q.roots: Folders where the game keeps its settings (one per line, empty line to finish)
wizard.q.seed: Before the game starts for %s: start from existing files
wizard.q.seed_files: Files to start from (one per line, empty line to finish)
wizard.q.seed_profile: Profile of that config to start from
wizard.q.track: Game process, if the launcher hands over to it (e.g. game.exe; empty otherwise)
wizard.restore_failed: the original files could not be put back (%v): their copy stays in %s, and pm new on the same config will put them back
wizard.seed.config: from an older pm config (a profile of pm-dcs.yaml, for example)
wizard.seed.files: from files chosen one by one
wizard.seed.folder: from a folder laid out like the game (%s)
wizard.seed.none: no: start from the current settings
wizard.seed_outside: %d files outside the watched folders, left out
wizard.stop_failed: %s (pid %v) did not stop: close it by hand
wizard.sum.backup: Archives %s into %s before each start, keeps the last %s
wizard.sum.srs: Stops SRS when the game closes
wizard.welcome: pm new — a few questions, and the config is ready. The config is written only after the final confirmation.
wizard.yaml_header:
# Created by pm new on %s.
# Launch: %s
